name: DCA | PIER Canning Vale data centre
developer: DC Alliance / Pier DC Pty Ltd (AsiaPhos acquisition)
notes: DCA | PIER is an Uptime Institute certified Tier III data centre at 1 Martin Place, Canning Vale industrial area, ~20km from Perth CBD, serving enterprise and government customers. w.media and The Edge Singapore report the facility operates a 2MW power installation supporting ~700kW of IT load with plans for modular expansion to 8MW; AsiaPhos agreed to acquire a majority stake in DC Alliance (owner of Pier DC) in 2026. Capacity 2 = current power installation, 8 = expansion target.

name: DC Two Bibra Lake Data Centre
notes: DC Two opened Bibra Lake Stage 1 (19 Horus Bend, Bibra Lake, City of Cockburn) online for customers in 2021; DCD reported a 5,000 sqm, 3MW facility with ~70 racks at 6kW average density and up to 30kW per rack. ASX announcements confirm Stage 1 operational; later crypto-mining deployments at the site. 3MW = Stage 1 power capacity.

name: Vocus DC-PER04 Henderson data centre
notes: Vocus lists DC-PER04 Henderson at 4 McGrath Rd, Munster WA 6166 (Henderson/Munster are within the City of Cockburn). Operational carrier facility; no public IT load figure found.

name: DC Two / D Coin Collie modular data centre
notes: DC Two announced a Collie behind-the-grid modular data centre beside a planned solar farm, first-phase power up to 4MW and ~256 racks (2022). A 2023 DCD article (LMS Energy biogas facility) still described the Collie solar-farm modular campus and a wind-farm campus north of Perth as 'in development'. No public evidence of energisation, so status remains planned.

name: Phaeton Networks Dalwallinu Shire modular data centre
notes: Phaeton announced (Jan 2022) deployment of eight ISO containerised modular data centres at Phaeton Energy microgrid solar farms across Australia, including one module at Dalwallinu Shire backed by a 1.5MW solar farm and 6MW battery system; prototype OMD 'ready to go live' at announcement. DCD noted deployment timelines were not shared; no public evidence the Dalwallinu module was deployed or energised, so status announced/lead.
